soru: Veri değerleme ve veri paraya çevirme için ölçütler, KPI'lar ve taksonomiler üzerine en önemli çalışmalar ve açık problemler neler?
istem:
Research question: Veri değerleme ve veri paraya çevirme için ölçütler, KPI'lar ve taksonomiler üzerine en önemli çalışmalar ve açık problemler neler?

Cutoff date: 2025-07-25. Only works published BEFORE this date count.

List the 30 most important works (papers) for this research question that were published before the cutoff date, in order of importance (most important first), each with its arXiv id and/or DOI. You may search the web.

When you are done, reply with ONLY a JSON object in this form (no other text):
{"calismalar": [{"sira": 1, "baslik": "exact title", "yil": 2020, "arxiv_id": "arXiv id or null", "doi": "DOI or null", "gerekce": "one sentence on why this work is important"}]}
with exactly 30 items. If you do not know an identifier, use null instead of guessing.

calismalar.baslik: Data Shapley: Equitable Valuation of Data for Machine Learning
calismalar.gerekce: This paper introduced the Shapley value as a principled, axiomatic measure of how much each data point is worth to an ML model.

calismalar.baslik: Towards Efficient Data Valuation Based on the Shapley Value
calismalar.gerekce: It made Shapley-based data valuation scalable with efficient approximation algorithms and brought the problem of computational cost into focus.

calismalar.baslik: Data Valuation in Machine Learning: "Ingredients", Strategies, and Open Challenges
calismalar.gerekce: This key survey sets out a taxonomy of data valuation methods and the main open problems.

calismalar.baslik: A Review of Data Valuation Approaches and Building and Scoring a Data Valuation Model
calismalar.gerekce: It groups business data valuation approaches (market-based, economic, dimensional) and proposes a scored valuation model, while noting that no standard exists.

calismalar.baslik: A Survey on Data Pricing: from Economics to Data Science
calismalar.gerekce: It brings together the principles, models and taxonomy of data pricing and monetization from both economics and data science.

calismalar.baslik: Big data monetization throughout Big Data Value Chain: a comprehensive review
calismalar.gerekce: This comprehensive review classifies data monetization models along the stages of the big data value chain.

calismalar.baslik: A Marketplace for Data: An Algorithmic Solution
calismalar.gerekce: It gave a foundational algorithmic framework for pricing data and splitting revenue in data markets.

calismalar.baslik: Beta Shapley: a Unified and Noise-reduced Data Valuation Framework for Machine Learning
calismalar.gerekce: It generalized Shapley by relaxing the efficiency axiom, which gives more robust value metrics based on semivalues.

calismalar.baslik: Data Banzhaf: A Robust Data Valuation Framework for Machine Learning
calismalar.gerekce: It proposed the Banzhaf value as a measure that holds up under noise and defined a robustness criterion for valuation metrics.

calismalar.baslik: Data Valuation using Reinforcement Learning
calismalar.gerekce: It introduced the learning-based data valuation (DVRL) approach, a distinct branch of the taxonomy.

calismalar.baslik: Understanding Black-box Predictions via Influence Functions
calismalar.gerekce: It established the influence-function family that measures how much each training example contributes.

calismalar.baslik: OpenDataVal: a Unified Benchmark for Data Valuation
calismalar.gerekce: It set standard tasks and benchmarks for comparing data valuation metrics.

calismalar.baslik: Data-OOB: Out-of-bag Estimate as a Simple and Efficient Data Value
calismalar.gerekce: It offered an out-of-bag data value metric that is cheap to compute and scales well.

calismalar.baslik: Efficient Task-Specific Data Valuation for Nearest Neighbor Algorithms
calismalar.gerekce: It made exact Shapley computation possible with KNN-Shapley, which became the practical baseline.

calismalar.baslik: A Distributional Framework for Data Valuation
calismalar.gerekce: It defined data value with respect to a data distribution, which allows values to be compared and transferred across datasets.

calismalar.baslik: LAVA: Data Valuation without Pre-Specified Learning Algorithms
calismalar.gerekce: It proposed a model-agnostic valuation metric based on optimal transport.

calismalar.baslik: Training Data Influence Analysis and Estimation: A Survey
calismalar.gerekce: This comprehensive survey sorts influence and data valuation measures into a taxonomy.

calismalar.baslik: Estimating Training Data Influence by Tracing Gradient Descent
calismalar.gerekce: TracIn introduced a training-trajectory-based influence metric that scales well.

calismalar.baslik: Datamodels: Predicting Predictions from Training Data
calismalar.gerekce: It brought in the datamodels approach, which links subsets of training data to model behavior.

calismalar.baslik: TRAK: Attributing Model Behavior at Scale
calismalar.gerekce: It made data attribution practical for large models.

calismalar.baslik: Query-Based Data Pricing
calismalar.gerekce: It is a foundational work on arbitrage-free, query-based data pricing for monetization.

calismalar.baslik: Data Pricing in Machine Learning Pipelines
calismalar.gerekce: It surveys pricing mechanisms at each stage of the ML pipeline: raw data, collaborative training and model sales.

calismalar.baslik: Advancing Data Monetization and the Creation of Data-based Business Models
calismalar.gerekce: It structures the research agenda on data monetization and data-based business models in information systems.

calismalar.baslik: A Systematic Survey of Data Value: Models, Metrics, Applications and Research Challenges
calismalar.gerekce: This systematic survey classifies data value models and metrics across organizational applications.

calismalar.baslik: What is the value of data? A review of empirical methods
calismalar.gerekce: It reviews empirical methods for measuring the economic value of data (cost-, market- and income-based).

calismalar.baslik: What is Your Data Worth to GPT? LLM-Scale Data Valuation with Influence Functions
calismalar.gerekce: It made data valuation feasible at LLM scale, which matters for data royalties and monetization.

calismalar.baslik: Data Shapley in One Training Run
calismalar.gerekce: It proposed computing Shapley values during a single training run (In-Run Data Shapley) for large-scale models.

calismalar.baslik: Rethinking Data Shapley for Data Selection Tasks: Misleads and Merits
calismalar.gerekce: It shows the limits and failure modes of Shapley-based value metrics, an important open problem.

calismalar.baslik: Collaborative Machine Learning with Incentive-Aware Model Rewards
calismalar.gerekce: It turned data valuation into incentive and reward mechanisms for collaborative learning.

calismalar.baslik: DataInf: Efficiently Estimating Data Influence in LoRA-tuned LLMs and Diffusion Models
calismalar.gerekce: It made influence-based data value estimation efficient for fine-tuned large models.
